name: protein kinase D3

function.text: PRKD3 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase D3. Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and protein phosphorylation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Polymorphous adenocarcinoma; Cribriform adenocarcinoma of salivary gland. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
